# 🚀 GitHub Project Specification: Ta3allam LMS Roadmap

## Project Metadata
- **Project Title**: `Ta3 LMS Product Roadmap & Sprints`
- **Owner**: `ta3allam`
- **Target Repository**: `ta3allam/ta3`

## Description
> **Ta3 (تعلّم)** is an Arabic-first, AI-boosted Learning Management System (LMS) built with React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, and PostgreSQL. 
> This project board orchestrates Sprint 1 (Foundation & Auth), Sprint 2 (LMS Core & Submissions), and Sprint 3 (Dockerization & Public Cloud Readiness), delegating engineering tasks across specialized agent personas (**Fai**, **BAI**, **ROAI**, **SAI**, **QAI**, **POAI**).

---

## Views & Fields Configuration
1. **Board View (Kanban)**:
   - Columns: `📋 Backlog` | `🚧 In Progress` | `🔍 In Review` | `✅ Done`
2. **Iteration View (Sprints)**:
   - **Sprint 1**: Foundation, Auth & Base API Integration (Week 1)
   - **Sprint 2**: LMS Core Workflows & AI Micro-Features (Week 2)
   - **Sprint 3**: Dockerization, Hardening & Public Readiness (Week 3)
3. **Roadmap View**:
   - Timeline visualization grouped by Milestone & Domain Label (`frontend`, `backend`, `ai`, `security`, `qa`, `devops`).
